redaction_policy: Remove lexical token IDs, prompt/response/message content and credentials recursively from JSON/JSONL/CSV; preserve expert IDs, token positions, counts and numerical measurements.
binary_policy: Credential-containing opaque binaries are excluded, with their exported CSV/JSON retained and sanitized. Clean native profiler files and nine synthetic tensor snapshots are preserved byte-for-byte. All source bytes credential-pattern screened; Torch pickle metadata inspected without execution. No credentials or credential-value hashes are published.
metadata_policy: Source paths in this manifest are relative to source_archive. Native capture metadata such as GPU UUIDs, host paths and numeric process IDs remains measurement provenance.
checksum_policy: SHA256SUMS covers every published regular file except itself, including this manifest. source_SHA256SUMS.txt, if present, refers to original source bytes and may name excluded historical files.
